replace_with_eetq_linear: replace all torch.nn.Linear modules in a model with EetqLinear quantized modules
create_eetq_linear_module: create an EetqLinear module with specified in_features, out_features, and optional bias
convert_weights_with_eetq_quantize: convert model weights to int8 quantized format with scales using EetqQuantize
run_eetq_forward_backward: run forward and backward pass with EetqLinearMMFunction autograd custom operation
test_eetq_quantization: test the EETQ int8 quantization on a PyTorch model's linear layers
